description:
• About our brand and products:
Henry’s Music is a modern instrument maker built on decades of craftsmanship. We design and assemble guitars and accessories with a focus on tone, playability, and long-term reliability.

• What makes us different:
We offer reasonably priced, high-quality instruments that are designed for real musicians. Every guitar is fully set up and checked by our team in the warehouse before it reaches the customer, ensuring consistent performance, comfort, and reliability.

• How Influencers can earn:
Influencers earn a commission on every completed sale made through their unique tracking link. Earnings grow with audience engagement, and all commissions are recorded automatically for full transparency.

• How to promote us:
Share your unique link in videos, tutorials, reviews, unboxings, or social posts. Authentic demonstrations and showcasing how the instruments feel and sound deliver the best results.

• Other information:
We have a dedicated Influencer Manager available to support you directly. Influencers always have a real contact person who can help with guidance, content ideas, and anything needed to maximise earnings and long-term success.

term_and_condition:
Henry's Music Influencer Terms and Conditions

Effective Date 1.12.2025

  1. Introduction
    These Terms and Conditions govern participation in the Henry’s Music Influencer Program. By creating an influencer account, you agree to be bound by these Terms, which form a legally binding agreement between you (“Influencer”) and Praha Music Center spol. s r.o., Ocelarska 937/39, 190 00 Prague, Czech Republic, Company ID: 18626459, VAT: CZ18626459 (hereinafter referred to as "Henry’s Music").

  2. Account Creation and Approval
    • All influencer accounts must be manually approved by Henry’s Music.
    • Influencers are required to provide accurate company information, including valid company details (if applicable), numbers and contact details.
    • Upon approval, each influencer receives a unique tracking URL and/or discount code generated through the UpPromote system on the Shopify Plus platform.
    • Only natural persons are eligible to participate. AI-generated personas, avatars, or virtual influencers are not permitted.

  3. Scope of Work
    • Influencers will promote Henry’s Music products via online platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, blogs, etc.
    • The influencer is responsible for generating content such as reviews and product highlights, mentioning “Henry’s Music” by name.

  4. Content Guidelines
    • All content must align with Henry’s Music brand values and promote products in a truthful manner.
    • Content must be original and created entirely by the influencer.
    • Content must be based on genuine, personal experiences using the actual product.
    • Content must not contain profanity, hate speech, misleading claims, or anything that could damage the reputation of Henry’s Music.
    • Discount codes and unique URLs must only be shared directly with followers (e.g., in stories or DMs).
    • Influencers agree to comply with all applicable advertising laws, including appropriate sponsorship disclosures (e.g., #ad, #sponsored).

  5. Compensation and Commission Structure
    • Influencers earn a commission for every completed sale made via their unique tracking link or assigned discount code within the UpPromote system.
    • Commission rates vary by product category and are visible to influencers in their program dashboard.
    • Henry’s Music reserves the right to change commission rates at any time without prior notice.
    • Commissions are calculated at the end of each calendar month and paid out after a 2-month delay to account for potential returns (e.g., commissions earned in May are paid in July).
    • If a product is returned within 30 days of purchase, the relevant commission is deducted from future payouts.
    • All orders must be manually reviewed and confirmed by Henry’s Music before any commissions are paid. Orders flagged for fraud, incomplete payment, or other issues are not eligible for commission.

  6. Cookie-Based Tracking
    • Commissions are tracked via cookies when a customer visits the website using the influencer’s unique link or uses the influencer’s assigned discount code.
    • Commissions apply to all purchases made by that customer according to the UpPromote attribution rules visible in the dashboard.

  7. Termination
    Either party may terminate the agreement under the following conditions:
    • By Henry’s Music: At any time, with immediate effect if the influencer breaches these Terms or engages in behavior that damages the brand.
    • By Influencer: With written notice of 14 days.
    All outstanding commissions earned prior to termination will be paid out according to the standard schedule.

  8. Confidentiality
    Influencers may not disclose confidential or proprietary information shared by Henry’s Music, including non-public business strategies, performance data, or marketing materials.

  9. Limitation of Liability
    Henry’s Music shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. The maximum liability under these Terms is limited to unpaid but earned commissions.

  10. Compliance with Law
    Influencers must comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to EU advertising standards, data protection (GDPR), and consumer rights.

  11. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
    These Terms are governed by the laws of the Czech Republic. Any disputes shall be submitted exclusively to the courts of the Czech Republic.

  12. Agreement to Terms
    By creating an influencer account, you confirm that:
    • You have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions.
    • You are a real person acting in your own name and not an AI-generated persona or virtual character.
    • You will comply with all guidelines regarding content authenticity and behavior.
